description: Look up a catalogued work by reviewed title alias, passage ID or work ID. Works may appear separately or inside larger publications. Return available languages and recorded source versions, including coverage and availability. Supply exactly one lookup parameter.

passage_id.description: Find work mappings associated with this passage occurrence.
passage_id.title: Passage Id

query.description: A reviewed title alias. Matching normalizes case, punctuation and diacritics. Example: Tablet of Ahmad.
query.title: Query

work_id.description: Retrieve the catalogue entry for this work ID.
work_id.title: Work Id

name: lookup_work
